/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls
from scipy.sparse import csc_matrix

base='extracted'
meta=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv')
print('meta shape', meta.shape)
print(meta['cell_type'].value_counts().sort_index())
counts=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
print('counts shape', counts.shape, 'index head', counts.index[:3].tolist(), 'cols head', counts.columns[:3].tolist())
# verify align
print('align', (counts.index.values==meta.iloc[:,0].values).all())
barcodes=[l.strip() for l in gzip.open(f'{base}/barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]
idx=barcodes.index('Spot_710-1')
print('spot idx',idx)
M=mmread(f'{base}/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsc() # genes x spots
spot=np.asarray(M[:,idx].todense()).ravel().astype(float)
print('spot total', spot.sum(), 'nnz', np.count_nonzero(spot), 'max', spot.max())
# cell type mean raw
celltypes=sorted(meta['cell_type'].unique())
means=[]; sums=[]
for ct in celltypes:
    X=counts.loc[meta.loc[meta['cell_type']==ct, meta.columns[0]].values].values.astype(float)
    means.append(X.mean(axis=0))
    sums.append(X.sum(axis=0))
A=np.vstack(means).T
coef, res=nnls(A, spot)
print('NNLS raw means res',res)
for ct,c in sorted(zip(celltypes,coef), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
    print(ct, c)
# normalized library size per type? Use proportions (mean normalized to sum=1), fit count total via coef = molecules/cells
An=A / A.sum(axis=0)
coef2, res2=nnls(An, spot)
print('NNLS profiles res',res2)
for ct,c in sorted(zip(celltypes,coef2), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
    print(ct, c, 'frac', c/sum(coef2) if coef2.sum() else 0)
# correlations to each type mean and marker score
corr=[]
for ct,v in zip(celltypes,means):
    corr.append((ct, np.corrcoef(spot, v)[0,1], np.dot(spot,v)/(np.linalg.norm(spot)*np.linalg.norm(v))))
print('corrs')
for row in sorted(corr,key=lambda x:-x[1]): print(row)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls
base='extracted'
meta=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv')
counts=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
cell_col=meta.columns[0]
celltypes=sorted(meta['cell_type'].unique())
A=np.vstack([counts.loc[meta.loc[meta.cell_type==ct, cell_col].values].values.mean(axis=0) for ct in celltypes]).T.astype(float)
print('types', celltypes)
print('mean library sizes')
for ct,lib in zip(celltypes,A.sum(axis=0)):
    print(ct, lib)
M=mmread(f'{base}/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsc().astype(float)
barcodes=[l.strip() for l in gzip.open(f'{base}/barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]
# fit target and neighboring/selected spots. array is 30x30, spot index row-major? spot 710 -> row 20 col 23? Actually positions below.
for spotid in ['Spot_710-1','Spot_709-1','Spot_711-1','Spot_680-1','Spot_740-1']:
    j=barcodes.index(spotid)
    y=np.asarray(M[:,j].todense()).ravel()
    coef,res=nnls(A,y)
    print('\\n',spotid,'total',y.sum(),'res',res)
    print(', '.join(f'{ct}:{c:.3f}' for ct,c in zip(celltypes,coef)))
# fit all spots quickly and inspect coefficient distribution near thresholds
coefs=[]
for j in range(M.shape[1]):
    y=np.asarray(M[:,j].todense()).ravel()
    coef,res=nnls(A,y)
    coefs.append(coef)
C=np.vstack(coefs)
pos=C[C>0]
print('\\ncoef quantiles positive', np.quantile(pos,[0,0.01,0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9,0.95,0.99,1]))
# sorted target coefs
j=barcodes.index('Spot_710-1')
coef=coefs[j]
print('target sorted', sorted(zip(celltypes,coef), key=lambda x:-x[1]))
# counts of coefficients > thresholds
for t in [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,0.8]:
    print('n >',t, (C>t).sum(axis=1).mean(), 'target', [ct for ct,c in zip(celltypes,coef) if c>t])

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, gzip
from scipy.io import mmread
from collections import defaultdict
base='extracted'
meta=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv')
counts=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/spatial_q_sc_counts.csv', index_col=0)
X=counts.values.astype(np.int16)
libs=X.sum(axis=1).astype(int)
barcodes=[l.strip() for l in gzip.open(f'{base}/barcodes.tsv.gz','rt')]
M=mmread(f'{base}/matrix.mtx.gz').tocsc()
y=np.asarray(M[:,barcodes.index('Spot_710-1')].todense()).ravel().astype(np.int16)
ysum=int(y.sum())
# hash exact cell vectors by bytes, grouped by lib
group=defaultdict(list)
for k,(lib,row) in enumerate(zip(libs,X)):
    group[int(lib)].append(k)
# one-cell exact
for k,row in enumerate(X):
    if np.array_equal(row,y): print('one', k, meta.loc[k,'cell_type'])
# pair/triple exact with library prefilter
found=[]
n=X.shape[0]
for i in range(n):
    xi=X[i]
    for j in range(i,n):
        rem_sum=ysum-int(libs[i])-int(libs[j])
        if rem_sum not in group: continue
        rem=y.astype(np.int32)-xi.astype(np.int32)-X[j].astype(np.int32)
        if (rem<0).any(): continue
        rem16=rem.astype(np.int16)
        for k in group[rem_sum]:
            if k<j: continue
            if np.array_equal(X[k], rem16):
                found.append((i,j,k, tuple(meta.loc[[i,j,k],'cell_type'])))
                print('triple', i,j,k, found[-1][3])
                raise SystemExit
print('found triples', len(found))
# closest triplet maybe not needed
PY"
